rule: Wellcome does not label biosecurity grants, so this is our rule: grants whose title names pandemic or epidemic threats (pandemics, outbreaks, COVID-19, Ebola and similar), or whose description is plainly about pandemic preparedness or biosecurity, leaving out routine diseases. Pounds are converted to dollars at each year's average rate. Counted only for organisations on the map, because the rule is too loose to trust for everyone else.
